description: Fuente unica del catálogo de origen React Bits de la fase 51. weight.mjs lo lee, mide los marcadores fx: y arma las tablas de system.html. Los nombres son los del indice vivo https://reactbits.dev/llms.txt.

rows.name: Grainient
rows.description: Flowing grainy gradients you can stir with the cursor.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: Único WebGL permanente: shader original de una pasada con fallback CSS de tres gradientes y grano SVG

rows.name: PatternWaves
rows.description: A lit halftone surface of dots, lines or glyphs that moves like draped silk.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: CSS en producción; shader halftone solo como demo opt-in

rows.name: CRTWarp
rows.description: A blocky plasma glowing on a curved CRT, with real scanlines, a phosphor mask, afterglow and a power-on intro.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: CSS en producción; shader de barril, scanlines y mascara de fosforo solo como demo opt-in

rows.name: MicroSlats
rows.description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: CSS en producción; columnas ondulantes solo como demo opt-in

rows.name: PixelBlast
rows.description: Dithered pixel clouds that drift, shimmer and light up under the cursor, with ripples, shapes and a perspective floor.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: Solo CSS: tramado conic-gradient de 6 px; sin shader

rows.name: PixelCard
rows.description: A card that fills with twinkling pixels on hover, rippling out from the center or the cursor.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: Solo CSS: la disolución en hover y en foco usa steps(); sin canvas 2D

rows.name: GradientASCII
rows.description: Soft gradient glows drawn in ASCII characters that scramble under the cursor.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: pre aria-hidden con el juego .:-=+*#%@ y ticker de texto a 10 fps

rows.name: ASCIIText
rows.description: Waving ASCII text that tilts toward the pointer, scrambles on hover and ripples on click.

originalWeight.source: esbuild sobre el código del componente, sin React ni ogl

rows.decision: Comparte el pre y el ticker de GradientASCII; el texto real vive en el DOM

rows.name: Noise
rows.description: Film grain overlay for photos and pages, from fine 35mm grain to dust, paper and TV static.
rows.decision: Capa SVG feTurbulence estática; variante viva en 4 posiciones discretas a 2 por segundo

rows.name: Dither
rows.description: Retro dithered waves with Bayer, halftone, line and noise patterns, palettes and cursor trails.
rows.decision: Tramado Bayer 4x4 estático en tres densidades; sin shader

rows.effect: Scout: imagen que se revela con trama
rows.name: Halftone Reveal
rows.description: A halftone print of an image whose dots swell into the real photo under the cursor.
rows.decision: img real visible sin JS; trama de puntos que se disuelve una sola vez; sin canvas

rows.name: Pixel Transition
rows.description: Retro pixel dissolve that covers a card in solid pixels, swaps the content underneath and clears again.
rows.decision: CSS puro con steps(); el foco por teclado dispara el mismo cambio que el hover

rows.effect: Scout: terminal CRT para 404 y contacto
rows.name: Faulty Terminal
rows.description: A flickering CRT terminal of glowing glyphs, with phosphor trails under the cursor and glitches on click.
rows.decision: Solo catálogo: su fallback estático es el de CRT warp (.fx-crt); no agrega shader

rows.effect: Scout: hover profesional de bajo costo
rows.name: Spotlight Card
rows.description: Card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, catches its edge and reaches nearby cards.
rows.decision: radial-gradient con --mx y --my; el JS solo sigue al puntero fino

rows.name: Gradient Blinds
rows.description: Satin gradient blinds lit by a spotlight that follows the cursor, swaying and turning toward the light.
rows.decision: Estático: --grad visto a través de una mascara de persianas; sin shader

rows.effect: Scout: borde de luz para el CTA
rows.name: Star Border
rows.description: A twinkling star that travels the exact outline of any button, pill or card, trailing light and stardust.
rows.decision: Aproximación en CSS: anillo conic-gradient con @property en vez de una estrella que recorre el contorno

rows.effect: Mención del scout: fondo de lectura
rows.name: Dot Grid
rows.description: A springy dot grid that the cursor flicks and drags through like jelly, with click shockwaves.
rows.decision: Solo la forma estática, unica decoracion admitida junto al grano en superficies de lectura

excluded.name: Folder

excluded.reason: Pesa 21 KB y depende de vgpu

excluded.name: GridScan
excluded.reason: Pesa 11 KB; solo valdria si sustituyera a otro shader

excluded.name: Pixel Snow
excluded.reason: Look estacional, fuera de la estética técnica

excluded.name: Plasma
excluded.reason: Look genérico, sin ventaja sobre Grainient

excluded.name: Silk
excluded.reason: Fuera del tono ASCII, pixel y tinta

excluded.name: Iridescence
excluded.reason: No encaja con tinta y fosforo

excluded.name: Glass Surface
excluded.reason: Contradice tinta y grano, con bajo contraste y 9 KB
